_description: Reviewer-scoped CREATE SOMETHING Hub endpoint for Webflow Template Review work in Claude Code.
_workway: Claude Code gets local shell access for URL probes and a reviewer-scoped MCP Hub for Airtable review queue reads/writes.
_requires: infisical CLI access to prod:/mcp-hub/hubs or WF_TEMPLATE_REVIEW_HUB_TOKEN
_setup: Use scope user for a reviewer machine, or project when intentionally sharing a non-secret .mcp.json.
Run claude mcp list and /mcp in Claude Code to confirm the server connects.
Ask Claude Code to list Hub services; it must return only webflow-template-review-mcp.
_security: The headersHelper prints only an Authorization header JSON object and keeps bearer values out of committed config.
The reviewer Hub must stay constrained to webflow-template-review-mcp.
Do not add webflow-site-analyzer-mcp back for Template Review reviewer Hubs.
